  "sql": "SELECT p.category, count(DISTINCT r.id) AS refund_count FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refund_count DESC LIMIT 1",
  "tables_used": ["refunds", "orders", "order_items", "products"],

Using COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) ensures each refund is counted only once, even if the order contains items from multiple categories. The LIMIT 1 returns only the top category with the highest refund count."
